title: Executive Operations Manager (Yönetişim Ritmi İşletmeni)

why: Its whole material is the holding's internal governance rhythm and CEO-view cycle-health section, nothing about building client websites.
problems: written for the holding's dashboard and CEO view (cycle-health section)
no web-craft content at all
too long (~18 KB) for a web job
written in Turkish, not English

title: Account Strategist

why: Its land-and-expand, QBR and champion-enablement method could later grow web clients into monthly care/SEO packages, but it is generic B2B account management with no web content.
problems: too long (~21 KB) for a web job
generic enterprise account management, nothing web-specific
post-sale only — not client finding
best_lines: expansion should feel to the customer like a natural next step they half-proposed themselves
QBRs are forward-looking strategy sessions, never backward-looking status theater — open with quantified ROI

title: Technical Writer (docs pod owner)
does: Writes developer documentation — READMEs, API references, tutorials, migration guides — with docs-as-code pipelines, Divio class separation and every example executed in a clean environment. Ships docs in the same change as the feature.
why: It writes developer docs, not persuasive site copy; useful only if a client web app needs a docs site or handover guide.
problems: developer-docs craft, not site copywriting
too long (~21 KB)
mentions the holding dashboard's EN/TR duality

title: Content Creator
does: Turns briefs into blog posts, scripts, case studies and conversion copy: angle memo first, claims sourced, separate draft/edit/voice-check passes, then a repurposing map. Every piece carries an assigned funnel job and is measured against it.

problems: too long (~20 KB) for a ~2 KB studio specialist
broad editorial-calendar/podcast/blog scope beyond site copy

best_lines: if a piece could plausibly appear on a competitor's blog with the logo swapped, it fails the angle test

title: Advertising / Commercial Director
does: Turns a client need into a one-page commercial brief, a selling idea, a campaign shape and a deliverable matrix (formats × durations × ratios × platforms) for the film studio, then reviews the cut against the brief. Tags every claim substantiated/softened/removed and prices the campaign in card minutes.
